title: אביי קשישא

paragraphs: Abaye the elder. Yevamot 24a; Shevuot 42b; Sanhedrin 7a. He posed a contradiction between Rav’s statements, Shabbat 56a. Abaye said, “The teaching of Abaye the elder is the difference between them,” for Abaye the elder taught, Ketubbot 94a.
